requirements.title: product catalog API returns a non-empty, well-formed product list
acceptanceCriteria: The response body contains a non-empty products array
Each product exposes id, name, and price fields
preconditions: The Automation Exercise public API is reachable
requirements.expectedOutcome: The catalog endpoint returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty, well-formed product list

requirements.title: anonymous visitor sees the All Products listing grid
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the products route shows the All Products heading
The products listing grid shows at least one product card with a visible product name
preconditions: Public Automation Exercise site is reachable at the configured non-secret base URL
Visitor is unauthenticated; listing requires no login
requirements.expectedOutcome: The All Products page renders a non-empty product listing grid (card grid, not an HTML table)
